name: Hostel Daze
s: Four wingmates, 1 Hostel, First Semester. 'Hostel Daze' tries to capture the hostel-culture (or its lack thereof) of an engineering college.

paragraphs.text: Hostel Daze is an Indian Hindi-language comedy drama television series created by Saurabh Khanna and written by Abhishek Yadav, Suprith Kundar, Harish Peddinti, Talha Siddhiqui. Directed Raghav Subbu, it stars Adarsh Gourav, Luv Vispute, Shubham Gaur, Nikhil Vijay and Ahsaas Channa in lead roles. Hostel Daze premiered on Amazon Prime Video on 13 December 2019. The series contains four seasons, with a total of 21 episodes of approximately 30 minutes each. Season 2 premiered on 23 July 2021, Season 3 premiered on 16 November 2022 and Season 4 premiered on 27 September 2023.
The series follows four hostel friends in their first year: Jhantoo (Nikhil Vijay), Ankit (Adarsh Gourav), Chirag (Luv), and Jaat (Shubham Gaur). They are new students on campus who become roommates.

Jessica Xalxo, writing for RollingStone India observed: "Instead of confronting the very real issues that students are faced with, Hostel Daze trivializes them to the point of tradition, normalization and acceptance. And in its portrayal of the truth lies an endorsement that feels both endemic and dangerous, beyond the trappings of the genre."
